DIR-NAME is the first 60 bytes of PRV-VARIANT, which is not a display name: for an individual it is last name (30) + first name (20) + the first 10 characters of the licence number; for a group or facility it is the legal name (40) + the first 20 of the DBA name. No trimming or spacing. (D-028)
OPEN statuses and WRITE status are never tested and RETURN-CODE is never set. (D-024)
